notes.title: Emlis Demo Update - New Content & Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
What's New
Enhanced User Interface: We have completely redesigned the user interface to match the full game experience, delivering a much more polished and immersive gameplay experience.

New Healing Items: We're excited to introduce healing items that significantly enhance the survival gameplay experience. These latest additions will transform your strategic approach to combat.

Improved Level Design: We have  reworked our level layouts to ensure all branching paths are visible and intuitive. These improvements create a significantly smoother navigation experience, eliminating confusion and keeping you focused on the adventure.

Download Now!
Update your Emlis demo today and experience these fantastic improvements firsthand. We can't wait for you to try everything we've been working on!
